video_title: What does Darryn Peterson canceling his workout with the Utah Jazz really mean? | Jazz Notes

quotes.speaker: Ben Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson canceled his workout with the Utah Jazz
quotes.excerpt: Darryn Peterson has canceled his workout in Utah.
quotes.quote: Darryn Peterson has canceled his workout in Utah. We will talk about that more. Obviously, I have some insight on what I believe happened there and what I have learned has happened there.

quotes.speaker: Ben Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson's camp is confident he will be the number one overall pick
quotes.excerpt: Darryn worked out with the Wizards and his camp came away very confident he's going to be the number one overall pick.
quotes.quote: Darryn worked out with the Wizards and his camp came away very confident he's going to be the number one overall pick, and therefore doesn't need to come to Utah because he's not going to be on the board.

quotes.speaker: Ben Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa is considered the top prospect on the Jazz's draft board
quotes.excerpt: Most people think AJ Dybantsa is the top of the Jazz's draft board.
quotes.quote: Most people think AJ Dybantsa is the top of the Jazz's draft board. Now, I don't know if I think that. In fact, I don't think that, but I could be way off. This is totally a guess on my part.

quotes.speaker: Ben Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Jazz are unlikely to trade up for Darryn Peterson unless they believe he is the clear best prospect
quotes.excerpt: I don't know if the Jazz were going to trade up to number one to get Darryn Peterson unless the Jazz had decided Darryn is so much better than everybody else.
quotes.quote: I don't know if the Jazz were going to trade up to number one to get Darryn Peterson unless the Jazz had decided Darryn is so much better than everybody else in this draft, they have to have him, they have to come away with that player specifically.

quotes.speaker: Ben Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer's best skill is his passing and playmaking
quotes.excerpt: I think his best skill is his passing. I think that is the selling point on Cameron Boozer.
quotes.quote: I think his best skill is his passing. I think that is the selling point on Cameron Boozer is the playmaking and the passing.

quotes.speaker: Ben Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer has the highest floor in the draft
quotes.excerpt: He has the highest floor, there is no question about that.
quotes.quote: He has the highest floor, there is no question about that. I wouldn't say he doesn't have an enormously high ceiling still, because there is a situation where four or five years down the road, he is the Luka of this draft.

quotes.speaker: Ben Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Jazz would have taken Darryn Peterson if he were available
quotes.excerpt: I wouldn't have been surprised if the Jazz had Darryn number one on their board.
quotes.quote: I wouldn't have been surprised if the Jazz had Darryn number one on their board. So in that sense, if everyone was thinking AJ was going to go one, I think the Jazz would have taken Darryn. If Darryn is off the board, I think there might be a slightly higher likelihood that it is Boozer.

quotes.speaker: Ben Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Ben Anderson's current draft board ranking for top prospects
quotes.excerpt: I would have AJ one, Peterson two, Boozer three, Caleb four on my board.
quotes.quote: I would have AJ one, Peterson two, Boozer three, Caleb four on my board. I don't have a board. I don't really try to do that very often, but when I, that's kind of what I settled on last night even before I heard all of this Darryn Peterson stuff.

quotes.speaker: Ben Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Jazz are unlikely to trade up for a player who hasn't visited
quotes.excerpt: I don't see the play from any of the three sides. I don't see Washington's side of it.
quotes.quote: I don't see the play from any of the three sides. I don't see Washington's side of it, in all honesty. I don't see the Jazz's side of it, and I don't see Darryn Peterson's side of it among the three.

quotes.speaker: Ben Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Jazz are unlikely to trade up for a player who hasn't visited
quotes.excerpt: I doubt it. I think you just do a phone call.
quotes.quote: I doubt it. I think you just do a phone call. You know, Quinn Snyder the day that Marcus Smart won Defensive Player of the Year over Rudy Gobert, Quinn talked about what a big fan he was of Marcus Smart and said actually the night before the draft, because famously Marcus was like, 'I'm not going there, they already have a point guard,' which was Trey Burke, but he's like, 'I'm not going to Utah, I'm not going to work out there because I don't want them to draft me.'
